description:
HushMessenger for Messenger 584.0.0.49.98, which needs Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer. 63 patches. New switches quiet incoming calls and hide the tab badges or the recent photo card, and they're off until you turn them on. An auto reply can send a picture after its text now. Hide inbox ads is gone, since 584 has no inbox ads left to hide. Source updates don't change installed apps.

### Reported issues

- [#69](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/69) New **Quiet incoming calls** switch under Conversations. Calls still come in, but Messenger doesn't ring, vibrate or pop the call up over what you're doing. The call waits in the notification shade with its Answer and Decline buttons, and a call you miss still shows up in the chat. If the Facebook app is on your phone, it can still ring for the same call. It starts off.
- [#81](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/81) New **Hide tab badges** switch under Navigation. It clears the red dots and counts from the tabs at the bottom and from the Facebook button at the top. Want one of them back, say the Chats count? Turn on its Keep switch right below. Restart Messenger after a change. It's off until you turn it on.
- [#85](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/85) New **Hide the recent photo card** switch under Photos and videos. Take a screenshot or a photo and Messenger puts a card above the message box offering to send it. With this on, the card doesn't show up. Anything you took is still in the gallery button when you want to send it. It starts off.
- [#64](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/64) With two gallery apps on the phone and neither set as the default, **Open your gallery app** sent you to a Samsung Gallery that listed photos only. Videos show up there now too, and Android's list of apps to pick from still holds just your galleries.
- [#64](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/64) and [#82](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/82) **Open your gallery app** lets you pick several photos and videos at once. Pick two or more and Messenger's Send to sheet opens with all of them and the chat you came from at the top, so one Send gets them there. Pick just one and it opens in Messenger's editor like before. Samsung's Gallery now asks for a tap on Done even when you pick a single photo.
- [#80](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/80) **Stop analytics uploads** now also stops the upload Messenger 584 starts from inside the app. On 584 Messenger can send its analytics batch, the one that holds the tap and scroll details from the report, without going through the background upload services the switch already stopped. With the switch on, that one doesn't start either.
- [#79](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/issues/79) An auto reply can send a picture too. Open a reply under **Auto reply** and tap **Add a picture**. The text goes out first and the picture follows a couple of seconds later in the same chat, with the same once-per-chat wait, Off and Pause as the text. HushMessenger keeps its own copy of the picture, so moving or deleting the original won't break the reply. If that copy is gone, or a Messenger update changed how photos are sent, the text still goes out on its own.

### Changed and fixed

- HushMessenger now patches Messenger 584.0.0.49.98 (version code 346814894) and no longer takes 583.0.0.29.95. That's the one arm64 build of 584 on [APKMirror](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/facebook-2/messenger/facebook-messenger-584-0-0-49-98-release/) so far. Every switch was checked against it again, so update Messenger to 584 before you repatch.
- **Hide inbox ads** is gone. Meta stopped selling Messenger inbox ads in November 2025, and Messenger 584 took out the ad cards the switch used to filter, so there's nothing left for it to hide. If you pick patches by hand in Morphe, it just won't be in the list anymore.
- The six photo and video switches now have their own **Photos and videos** group, in Morphe's patch list and on the settings Controls tab alike: original quality photos and videos, **Fix videos that won't send**, the camera and gallery app switches, and **Hide the recent photo card**. Conversations had grown too long to scan. The Chats filter still shows them.
- **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** now stay at the top of the icon's long-press menu while Messenger sits in the background. New messages used to push them below the four rows your launcher shows until you next opened and left Messenger. Android 9 and 10 still put them back only when Messenger opens or closes.
- Hiding Quick setups with a long press now names the button that brings it back, **Quick setups section** under Your choices. The old message sent you to the App tab you were already on, and the button talked about a home page that doesn't exist.
- A video picked in a chat whose access ran out before or during the send no longer gets **Fix videos that won't send** marked as failing in settings. It goes out the way Messenger would send it anyway.
- If the phone's sound encoder won't start while a video's sound is being fixed, it's let go right away instead of staying held until Messenger closes.
- The copies **Fix videos that won't send** makes of videos you pick now go a day after their last use, even if you never pick another video or you've turned the switch off. Messenger clears them when it starts and again while it's open as each one's day runs out. They used to sit in Messenger's cache until the next pick.
- Android 12 and newer show only two lines of a pop-up message and cut the rest with "...", which hid the useful part of 27 of HushMessenger's. They're shorter now and fit, from the font file and backup messages to the camera, gallery and restart ones.
- Restoring your choices pops up how many of them it actually changed ("Changed 3 of 58 choices"), that none changed, or that they already match the backup, plus "Changes paused" or "Changes resumed" when the backup pauses or unpauses them. It used to count every choice in the backup, even ones that were already set that way, and the pause along with them. It only says they match when nothing in the backup was skipped or left off. Skipped choices and Auto reply staying off used to run past the end of that message. Now the whole result stays written under the backup buttons.
- When reading a choices file takes too long, the message says your choices didn't change. It used to warn that a saved file may be cut off, which is only true when saving one.
- If settings can't open from the side menu or the Messenger logo, two short messages now say so and then name the other way in. One message was too long and lost its second half.
- Picking a font file while **Use your own font** is off now says to turn the switch on, instead of telling you to restart Messenger. The file's name stays on the line under the button, where a long one can't push the rest off the message.
- **Use system emoji** loads the phone's emoji font once, even when Messenger asks for it from several threads at the same moment. Each thread could load its own copy before.
- When the message log can't save new messages (the phone's key store is busy, say), it tries again by itself 30 seconds later, then less often while it keeps failing. Those messages used to wait for the next notification and were lost if Messenger closed first.
- **Back to defaults**, the other Quick setups and **Clear log** each show an Undo button at the top of settings for about 10 seconds, and the emptied log shows one too. Clear log still deletes the saved messages and their key right away. Undo writes them back from a copy kept in memory until the button goes, and leaving settings makes the change final. Undo leaves alone any switch you flipped yourself after the change.
- The **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** long-press shortcuts now tell your launcher when you use them, so it can rank them by use the way it does Messenger's own chat shortcuts.
- On a Root Mount install, **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** never actually showed up on Messenger's icon. Android turned down the icons they used. They show up now.
- Each way back into settings now has its own switch on the App tab, as asked in [HushFacebook#146](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushFacebook/issues/146). Next to **Hide the Menu row** there's **Hide the icon shortcuts**, which takes **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** off the menu you get by long-pressing Messenger's home screen icon, and **Ignore the logo long press**. The last way in that's still on can't be switched off: its switch goes gray and says why, and if a saved choice leaves nothing else, the icon shortcuts come back by themselves. Pause and safe mode leave these switches alone, since they're how you get back in to undo either. If the logo long press is what lets the Menu row stay hidden, the row comes back after an update or a repatch until one long press on the logo opens settings again.
- The two icon shortcuts now come from HushMessenger each time Messenger starts, on every install, which is what lets the new switch take them away. After updating, they show up again a moment after you first open Messenger. Messenger's own chat shortcuts can push them down that menu while it's open, so they move back to the top each time you leave Messenger. On a normal install, a copy you pinned to the home screen before this update stops working, so remove it and pin a new one. Copies pinned from now on turn gray while the shortcuts are hidden and work again once they're back.
- When Messenger's chat shortcuts already fill everything Android lets one icon hold, the lowest of them now make room, so **Patch controls** and **Restart Messenger** still get on. Android refused to add them to a full icon before. Those are the same chat shortcuts Android drops when Messenger adds one to a full icon itself.
- In the settings cards, the line between switches now sits below a switch's own buttons (Keep the Profile button, the bubble choices, the font file, message log and auto reply buttons) instead of between the switch and them. The last switch in a card no longer draws a second line just above the card's edge.
- With a keyboard or a remote, the focus outline on a filled settings button (Restart Messenger, Save, the selected tab and filter) is now two rings, a dark and a light one, so it shows up against the button and the page in both themes. The single gray ring was hard to see on the button's own color.
- The settings call each thing by one name now. Controls are the switches, and your choices are what you set them to. The clipboard backup buttons are **Copy choices** and **Paste choices**, since Export and Import sat right next to the file buttons and sounded like them. The third bubble mode is **Android bubbles**, which is what Android calls them. Flipping a control pops up "Hide stories and notes is on" instead of "Hide stories and notes on", and **Fix videos that won't send** says what it does before it names the sound format.
- Two patches got plainer names, in Morphe's patch list and in settings. **Turn off the swipe up for disappearing messages** is now **Ignore the swipe up for disappearing messages**, and **Stop MQTT logging** is now **Stop live connection logging**. Morphe remembers your picks by name, so if you'd left either one out, it'll be picked again. Uncheck it before you repatch.
- With **Hide People tab**, **Hide Notifications tab** or **Hide Meta AI** on, the bar at the bottom now lights up the tab you're actually on. With People hidden, opening Notifications used to light up Menu instead.
- Some accounts get Meta's newer AI agent tab in the bar where the Meta AI tab usually sits. **Hide Meta AI** now hides that one too, and the bar still lights up the right tab. Restart Messenger to see it go.
- On a new install of a patched Messenger, **Bold** and **Italic** no longer show up in the text selection menu while **Bold and italic text** is off. Messenger's very first start turned them on, and they stayed there until you opened Messenger a second time. Updating over an existing install never did this.
- **Hide AI sticker tools** now hides the plain **Generate** button at the start of the sticker keyboard's Suggested row too. Accounts that get more than one sticker maker see that button instead of **Generate AI stickers**, and it opens a menu with AI stickers in it, so the switch used to miss it. The custom and music stickers in that menu are hidden along with it while the switch is on.
- With **Hide AI sticker tools** on, the rest of the Suggested row now moves up to fill the spot where **Generate** or **Generate AI stickers** used to sit. The button went away before, but its slot at the start of the row stayed blank.
- HushMessenger is now built for Morphe's 2.0 patcher, so this release needs **Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer**. Update Manager first, then repatch. Every patch still applies to Messenger 584 and the patch count is the same.

### Docs

- The README's troubleshooting list now covers a cloned Messenger showing the settings icon again, chats and calls notifying twice because of the Facebook app, and restoring chats with a PIN when the Google Drive restore errors out.

### Checks

- A release can't go public until the whole app has been walked with that exact bundle on a release phone or an emulator. The publish stage now takes the walk's receipt as `-Walk` and stops before the tag or GitHub if the walk wasn't a full pass, saw a Messenger crash, ran on some other device, or patched with a different bundle.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` does that walk. It patches Messenger from the bundle, installs it in place on a leased phone or an emulator, opens both settings pages, a chat and the patched screens, then reads the crash buffer and writes the receipt publish asks for. Any Messenger crash fails the walk. Leaving out a page or a screen makes it partial, and neither one backs a release. The receipt also names the APK patched from the bundle and the one the phone actually ran, and publish wants them to match, so walking whatever was already installed (`-SkipPatch`) only counts when it's that same APK. A crash buffer the walk can't read fails it, and the script exits 0 only for a pass (2 for partial, 1 for a fail). A walk that finds the device busy keeps the APK it patched, so the next try goes straight to the device instead of patching again.
- The development release check, the one a held build goes through, fails when the source has no bundle timestamp. Before, a bundle and a source both missing one counted as a match there. The full release check already refused it, and now it says why.
- A Gradle run through this PC's build wrapper fails when the wrapper itself errors out before Gradle starts. It used to exit 0 and read as a pass.
- Recording a Messenger build with `CompatReport.java --save` refuses an APK that isn't signed by Facebook or Meta, or whose signer apksigner can't read. A record pins the APK's checksum, so a re-signed copy could have been written down as the stock build. The release build stage also checks each stock APK against the checksum in its record before patching it, and CompatReport looks for Python as `py`, `python3` or `python` (never the Windows Store stub) instead of assuming `python`.

patches.name: Allow chat bubbles
patches.description: Lets you pick Stock, Chat heads or Android bubbles for floating chats. Needs Android 11 or newer. Chat heads also needs Messenger's own Chat heads switch, and Android bubbles need Messenger's bubbles allowed in Android's notification settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Lets you screenshot protected chat media, such as view-once photos and Quicksnap, and stops screenshot notices. It doesn't add replay or saving. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Auto reply
patches.description: Answers messages with replies you write in HushMessenger settings, when they have words you pick or any message at all. Replies go out through Messenger's own notification reply, encrypted chats too, at most once every five minutes per chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Bold and italic text
patches.description: Adds Bold and Italic to the menu that shows when you select words you typed. They're special Unicode letters, so they show on any phone, but screen readers may read them oddly. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Clone install under another package name
patches.description: Installs a second copy of Messenger beside the first, with its own app name. Push notifications may not reach the copy. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

options.description: The name shown under the copy's home screen icon. Up to 40 characters, starting with a letter or number.
The copy's unique app ID, like com.facebook.orca.hush. Use words joined by dots, each starting with a letter. It can't match Messenger or another Meta app.

patches.name: Custom new-message sound
patches.description: Replaces Messenger's new-message sound with an .ogg, .mp3, .m4a or .wav file (1 MB or less) that you choose. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

options.description: Your .ogg, .mp3, .m4a or .wav file, 1 MB or smaller. Leave it empty to keep Messenger's own sound.

patches.name: Fix videos that won't send
patches.description: Messenger stops two kinds of video with "Unable to send". One is a video whose only sound is xHE-AAC, which Facebook and Instagram now use. The other is a Samsung screen recording whose recorder tag Messenger's media check rejects. Whether you share one into Messenger from another app or pick it in a chat, the sound is converted to regular AAC, or the tag is dropped, so it sends. The picture isn't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide AI sticker tools
patches.description: Hides the Generate and Generate AI sticker buttons, the AI sticker tab and AI sticker suggestions. Custom and music stickers in the Generate menu go with it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide Chat Moments
patches.description: Hides Chat Moments in the menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide Facebook shortcuts
patches.description: Hides Facebook buttons, profile and sharing shortcuts, and the Also from Meta and Subscriptions sections in the Menu tab. Handy if you only use Messenger. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide Mark as read
patches.description: Hides Mark as read in the menu you get when you press and hold a chat in your chat list, so you can't mark a chat read by accident. Mark as unread stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI
patches.description: Hides the Meta AI floating button, toolbar button, tab and menu entries, plus AI in search and in @ suggestions. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide Notifications tab
patches.description: Hides the Notifications tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide People You May Know
patches.description: Hides suggested people in chats, search and stories, and on the People and Notifications tabs, so you only see people you know. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide People tab
patches.description: Hides the People tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide Reels badge
patches.description: Hides the Reels notification badge. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide ad banners in business chats
patches.description: In a chat you started from a business's ad, hides the banner that shows that ad. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide avatar stickers
patches.description: Hides the avatar tab in the sticker keyboard. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide business reply suggestions
patches.description: Hides suggested replies in conversations with businesses. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide business typing suggestions
patches.description: Hides business suggestions that pop up as you type. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide chat promotions
patches.description: Hides promotion banners inside conversations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide event prompts
patches.description: Hides event promotion prompts inside chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide friend request cards
patches.description: Hides friend request cards in your chat list so they stop taking up room. It doesn't accept or decline anyone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide growth prompts
patches.description: Hides prompts to add more people, the tip sheets in notes (like Make my notes public), and the Share your own story card after someone else's stories. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide inbox promotions
patches.description: Hides promotion banners in your chat list. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide inbox tabs
patches.description: Hides the Home and Channels tabs inside your inbox. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide joined community chats
patches.description: Hides the community chats you joined from your main chat list. Search and community folders still show them. Messages and unread counts don't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide read receipts
patches.description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you read their message, and the chat stays unread on this phone. Marking it read yourself or replying in it marks it read and shows Seen, like Messenger does. Group chats aren't tested. Messenger's own Read receipts setting under Privacy & safety marks chats read without showing Seen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide stories and notes
patches.description: Hides the row of stories and notes above your chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide tab badges
patches.description: Hides the red dots and counts on the tabs at the bottom and on the Facebook button at the top. Turn on Keep for any you still want. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide the recent photo card
patches.description: Stops the card above the message box that offers to send the screenshot, photo or video you just took. You can still send it from the gallery. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hide typing indicator
patches.description: Stops Messenger from showing others when you're typing, even in end-to-end encrypted chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Hold stories at the end
patches.description: Keeps a story on screen when it ends instead of moving on to the next one, so you go on with a tap or a swipe. Photos and videos both wait, and the last story stays open until you close it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Ignore the swipe up for disappearing messages
patches.description: Swiping up at the bottom of a chat no longer turns on disappearing messages, so a scroll can't set the timer by accident. You can still change it in the chat's settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Install beside Meta apps
patches.description: Lets your patched Messenger install next to Facebook and other Meta apps. Without it, the apps can clash over shared permissions and the install can stop at a blank screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Keep a message log
patches.description: Saves each message when its notification arrives, so you can still read it if it's unsent. Works in end-to-end encrypted chats too. Stays on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Keep emoji search on emoji
patches.description: Typing while the emoji keyboard is open no longer jumps to sticker search. The keyboard stays on emoji. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Keep unsent messages
patches.description: Keeps messages on screen after someone unsends them, in chats where it works. Encrypted chats aren't supported, and group chats aren't tested. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Mark as read button
patches.description: Puts Messenger's Mark as read icon in a chat's top bar while Hide read receipts is on. Opening the chat still sends nothing, and a tap on the icon sends Seen and marks the chat read. It takes the place of the chat details button, since tapping the chat's name opens the same page, so the call buttons stay put. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Material You theme
patches.description: Colors Messenger's dark mode with your wallpaper colors on Android 12 and newer, and a fixed blue on Android 11. Light mode stays the same. Turn on dark mode in Messenger first. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Open settings from menu
patches.description: Adds a HushMessenger entry to Messenger's Menu tab and side menu, and makes a long press on the Messenger logo at the top of Chats or on the Menu tab's title open these settings too. Works as soon as you patch it in. The settings App tab can turn off each way in, as long as one stays on.

patches.name: Open web links externally
patches.description: Opens web links (http and https) in your default browser instead of inside Messenger. Other link types work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Open your gallery app
patches.description: The gallery button in a chat opens your phone's own gallery app. One photo or video opens in Messenger's editor for that chat, ready to send. Pick several and Messenger's Send to sheet opens with all of them and that chat at the top. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Pin more chats
patches.description: Raises Messenger's limit of three pinned chats to 20, so you can keep more chats at the top of your chat list. Messenger's servers can still stop you sooner. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Quiet incoming calls
patches.description: Calls still come in, but Messenger doesn't ring, vibrate or pop the call up over your screen. The call waits in the notification shade with Answer and Decline. A call you miss still shows in the chat. If the Facebook app is on your phone, it can still ring for the same call. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Restore old emoji drawer
patches.description: Turns off Meta's redesigned emoji keyboard, so you keep the earlier layout. Restart Messenger after changing it. If Meta never gave you the redesign, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches.description: Patching and signing Messenger yourself can break some of its screens. This makes Messenger's signature check pass again, including for a Facebook you patched with the same key, and lets Threads and Instagram video links open in a Threads or Instagram you patched yourself. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Save any story
patches.description: Adds Save to the More options menu on other people's stories, so you can keep their photo or video on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Send photos at original quality
patches.description: With HD on, sends a JPEG photo at its full size instead of Messenger's smaller copy, so it stays sharp. Location is still removed. Photos over 20 MB are still made smaller. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Send videos without re-encoding
patches.description: Sends a video as the original file instead of a recompressed copy, when Messenger allows it. Videos over 25 MB, edited videos and some formats are still compressed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Slide chats in and out
patches.description: Slides a chat in from the side when you open it and back out when you go back. Chat heads and bubbles keep their own animations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Spoof package version
patches.description: Gives Messenger a high version number so the Play Store stops offering Meta's updates. Messenger may report it to Meta. Going back means uninstalling first, which erases its data. Pick it in Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

options.description: A whole number up to 2147483647, no lower than the Messenger you're patching. Pick one higher than Messenger's version in the Play Store, or it will keep offering updates. The default is the highest Android allows.

patches.name: Stop ad attribution uploads
patches.description: Stops the job that reads your phone's advertising ID and sends it to Meta with your ad tracking setting. The ID itself doesn't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Stop analytics uploads
patches.description: Stops the background services Messenger uses to upload usage statistics. It still records them on your phone, and they can upload after you turn this off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Stop app list and device ID sharing
patches.description: Stops Messenger from going through the apps on your phone to find other Meta apps, and from asking them for the device ID Meta uses to link the apps on one phone. Messenger keeps the ID it already has. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Stop inbox and ad link logging
patches.description: Stops two reports Messenger logs. One says which part of your chat list was on screen, which Messenger files under inbox ads. The other says which ad brought you in when a link from an ad opens a chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Stop live connection logging
patches.description: Drops the health reports and push logging Messenger sends over its live connection (MQTT). Messenger sends most of its traffic another way, so there's often little for it to drop. Messages, calls and active status keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Stop nearby scans
patches.description: Stops Messenger from reading the list of Wi-Fi networks around you, and hides the name and hardware address of the one you're connected to, the way Android does when Messenger can't see your location. Also stops the timer it can run while it's open to check your location and scan for Wi-Fi networks and Bluetooth devices. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Unlock app icons
patches.description: Lets you pick any icon in Messenger's App icon setting without a subscription. Messenger still decides whether that setting shows for your account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Use system emoji
patches.description: Shows emoji in your phone's own style instead of Messenger's. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Use the phone's camera app
patches.description: The camera button in a chat opens your phone's own camera app. The photo then opens in Messenger's editor, ready to send. Photos only. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: Use your own font
patches.description: Shows Messenger's text in your phone's font instead of Meta's, or in a .ttf or .otf file you pick in HushMessenger settings. Emoji don't change. Restart Messenger after changing it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches.name: View stories anonymously
patches.description: Opens other people's stories without adding you to their viewer list. Messenger still marks them as seen on your side. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

release_notes:
HushMessenger for Messenger 585.0.0.53.94, all 7 arm64 and armv7 builds, which needs Morphe Manager 2.3.0 or newer. 71 patches. The bundle is signed now, and new switches save the voice messages you play, put gallery picks straight into the chat and let calls from chosen people come in without a ring. Material You takes your own colors, and the settings speak Vietnamese. Source updates don't change installed apps.

### New in this release

- `Quiet incoming calls` has a new **Only chosen chats** switch under it. Turn it on, then pick from the people who called you lately (they're listed newest first), and only their calls come in without a ring. Everyone else rings as usual. Refs #117.
- `Android Auto messages` is a new switch under Conversations. Android Auto only reads a message out and takes a spoken reply when the notification has a mark-as-read action, and Messenger's don't, so Auto fell back to treating them as plain alerts. With the switch on, each message notification carries Messenger's own car mark-as-read as an action you never see on the phone, right next to Messenger's Reply. Android Auto only lists apps installed from the Play Store until you turn on Unknown sources in its developer settings. It's experimental and starts off. Refs #75.
- `Hide the Instants button` is a new switch under Inbox. It hides the + button that slides in at the right edge of your chat list and opens Instants, on every 585 build. Not every account gets that button, so the switch is experimental. Refs #118.
- `Hide the Instants button` also covers the Instants button under your chat heads, the one that sits right where your thumb goes when you reach for a chat. Refs #104.
- `Save voice messages you play` is a new switch under Photos and videos. Each voice message you play also lands in Recordings/Messenger on your phone (Music/Messenger on Android 10 and 11), so a file manager or another player can open it later. Playing the same one again doesn't make a second copy. It needs Android 10 or newer and starts off. Refs #90.
- `Put gallery picks in the chat` is a new switch under Photos and videos that goes with `Open your gallery app`. What you pick in your gallery app goes straight into the chat you came from, above the message box, instead of Messenger's editor or the Send to sheet. Pick one photo or a dozen, then tap Send when you're ready. Nothing goes out on its own. It also brings that row above the message box to accounts where Messenger hadn't turned it on yet. A chat that was already open when you flipped the switch needs opening again. Starts off. Refs #101.
- HushMessenger's settings speak Vietnamese when your phone is set to it, in any region. Thanks to @hautv404 for the translation. Refs #113.
- **GmsCore support** is a new patch that starts unselected, for phones running microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Messenger asks microG-RE for its push token, so it can stay signed in. It's experimental. Leave it out on a phone with Play services. Refs #119.
- Material You can use your own colors now. Under Appearance, copy a theme like `{"name": "Sunset", "accent": "#E1306C", "neutral": "#1A1418", "pure_black": true}` and tap **Use copied theme**. The accent replaces Messenger's blues and the neutral tints its grays and backgrounds in dark mode, at Messenger's own brightness so text stays readable. **Copy theme** hands you the colors in use to tweak or share, and **Back to wallpaper colors** drops it. Refs #115.
- `Keep a message log` marks a message Unsent when the sender takes it back, encrypted chats included, and the log page has a **Show only unsent** button for finding them. With `Keep unsent messages` on, it also tries to keep an unsent message's notification up, even when it was the only message the notification showed, since an encrypted chat can't keep the message on screen. That notification part is experimental. Refs #70.
- The patch bundle is signed now. Morphe Manager 2.3 and newer checks the signature inside the `.mpp` before it loads HushMessenger, and once it has seen this key it won't take a bundle signed with another one. Manager shows the key as `4d8d c2b3 fbcd 3ab6`, and the README has a command for checking a download by hand. Older Managers don't look at it.

### Fixes and changes

- On a Samsung phone, `Bold and italic text` now tells you where to switch Bold and Italic on. Samsung keeps other apps' entries out of the text menu until you tick them under the three dots and Manage apps, so turning on the switch alone looked like it did nothing. Refs #42.
- The README's troubleshooting list now covers a login that gets past the password and then loops on a browser check. That's an account with a passkey, and removing the passkey on the web lets Facebook fall back to approving the login from another device. Refs #108.
- HushMessenger now targets Messenger 585.0.0.53.94 and takes all 7 builds APKMirror lists for it, five for arm64 and two for armv7. 584.1.0.61.98 is no longer supported, so update Messenger before you patch. Each build was checked patch by patch, and Morphe Desktop applied and rebuilt every one of them.
- `Hide Facebook shortcuts` now also hides the View profile button under the person's name and picture at the top of a chat with no messages yet. It opened their Facebook profile. With `Keep the Profile button` on, that one stays too.
- `Hide inbox tabs` now says what it hides on 585: the All, Unread and Groups tabs above your chats. The old text named Home and Channels tabs Messenger doesn't show anymore. Checked on 585, where On hides the tabs and Off or Pause brings them back.
- With `Open your gallery app`, a photo or video you pick in Google Photos that's already saved on your phone now reaches Messenger as the phone's own copy, which Messenger reads with its own photo and video access. Before, the upload had to go through Google Photos' permission. Items that only live in the cloud, and anything Messenger can't open itself, go through as picked. Refs #103.
- Opening a new issue on GitHub now offers a bug report form and a feature request form. The bug form asks for your versions, how you got your patched Messenger (Morphe Manager, Morphe Desktop, morphe-cli or a prebuilt APK), which patches source you added, the phone and where in Messenger it happened, so a report can be looked into without a round of questions first. Other sources carry HushMessenger's patches built from other code, and the source address tells them apart. **App > Report a problem** still opens a blank issue with those facts already filled in.
- The README's Install step says what Manager 2.3 and newer shows as this project's signing key, and its Help section explains the "Key changed" badge. It means the bundle was signed with another key and came from somewhere other than this source, so remove that source and add this one again instead of tapping Trust.
- The README's Help section explains why videos can go missing from Messenger's own picker on Android 14 and newer: with Messenger's photo access set to "Allow limited access" the picker shows only the items you chose. "Allow all" or `Open your gallery app` brings them back. Refs #114.
- With `Square profile pictures` on, the story ring around a picture in your chat list is square too, or rounded with **Round the corners**, so it hugs the picture instead of circling it. A ring that's still filling in follows the same edge. The ring part is experimental. Refs #116.
- `Hide stories and notes` also takes away the story rings around people's pictures in your chat list, the colored circle that says someone posted. It works with or without `Square profile pictures`, and like the square ring it's experimental. Refs #118.
- The patches are built with Morphe patcher 2.1.0 now, the patcher that comes with Morphe Manager 2.3.0 and Morphe Desktop 1.20.0. Manager won't load a bundle made with a newer patcher than its own, so update Manager to 2.3.0 or newer, or Desktop to 1.20.0, before you add this release.

### Behind the scenes

- The release check reads the bug form's version placeholder and refuses a release where it names another HushMessenger version or a Messenger build the bundle doesn't target. Prepare moves it along with the README.
- The release check reads which patcher built the bundle from its manifest and wants the README to ask for the first Morphe Manager and Morphe Desktop that come with it. Install steps can't send anyone to a Manager too old to load the release. Between releases the README keeps naming what the published release needs.
- The release check refuses a bundle holding a class file compiled for anything newer than Java 17 and names the entry, since morphe-patcher 2.1 won't load one. Entries under `META-INF/versions/` are left alone, as the patcher leaves them.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` now patches the stock APK of the build the device already runs when you don't pass `-Apk`. It reads the installed version code and picks that build from `HUSH_NATIVE_FIXTURES`, so the install no longer dies on `INSTALL_FAILED_VERSION_DOWNGRADE` or lands a different ABI or screen density. When no fixture is that build, it stops and says which builds it has.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` now waits up to 90 seconds after it installs Messenger, until the chat list or the restore prompt shows. The first start after an update upgrades Messenger's data, and until that's done a chat link opens a blank screen. On an x86_64 emulator, a crash inside the emulator's ARM translator while Messenger forks a helper process is still reported, but it no longer counts as a Messenger crash, since a phone doesn't run that translator.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` closes the keyboard before it reads each screen. A chat with no messages yet puts the cursor in the message box, the keyboard comes up, and with it open the screen read failed, so the walk reported the chat as having no screen to check. The keyboard can also come up a moment after the chat loads, so the walk checks again after closing it and tries the screen read up to three times.
- Publish now writes the GitHub release notes in the layout v0.27.0's notes were redone in by hand. They open with the release summary, then carry every CHANGELOG bullet word for word under New in this release, Fixes and changes and Behind the scenes, followed by the reports the release touched, How to update, and What was checked, which comes from the walk that cleared the bundle. Publish stops before tagging when a bullet would go missing or a line uses a dash.
- The release check refuses a bundle that isn't signed, was signed with a key other than the one in `morphe-signing.pub`, or was changed after signing. It also wants that key in the source's `public_key` and its fingerprint in the README. `release.ps1` reads the private key from `-BundleKey` and the build signs with it, while everyday builds without the key stay unsigned.
- The settings screen's code is split up. Auto reply's sheet, the message log viewer, theme colors, the choices backup, the custom font rows, the update check and Copy setup each have a file of their own now, which takes the settings page itself from about 3,600 lines to about 1,500. Nothing you see or tap changed.
- The build moved to Gradle 9.8.2 and Kotlin 2.4.21, both bugfix releases. The patches used to mix Kotlin 2.4.20 and 2.4.21 across the compiler, plugin and library, and now one version covers all three. The bundle's classes still target Java 11.

### Reports this release changed something for

#42, #70, #75, #90, #101, #103, #104, #108, #113, #114, #115, #116, #117, #118 and #119.

Full history is in the [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

### How to update

1. Update Messenger to 585.0.0.53.94 first. Any build on [APKMirror's 585.0.0.53.94 page](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/facebook-2/messenger/facebook-messenger-585-0-0-53-94-release/) works, and a `nodpi` one keeps the icons sharp.
2. In Morphe Manager (2.3.0 or newer), open **Sources** and refresh HushMessenger. The card should say **71 patches**.
3. Patch Messenger again and install it over your current one. Your settings carry over.

Patching on a computer? `patches-0.28.0.mpp` below is the same bundle for Morphe Desktop 1.20.0 or newer. It's a patch bundle, not a Messenger APK. `SHA256SUMS.txt` and its signature let you check the download, and the README says how.

### What was checked

- The full test suite, plus a patch run against all 7 Messenger 585.0.0.53.94 builds on file.
- Morphe Desktop patched and rebuilt one APK from each of the 4 build families.
- An APK patched from this exact bundle was installed on an emulator on Android API 32, signed in to Messenger. A chat, the inbox, both HushMessenger settings tabs, the message log, auto reply, Messenger's own settings, story settings and contact settings all opened, with no crashes.
repoDescription: Morphe patches for Facebook Messenger. Privacy switches and fewer promotions.
